rothses_1.m: Hi. How may I help you? A new set of boots perhaps, or some new gloves?
r: Let me see what you have for sale.
Jhaeld sent me to ask you about the people that have gone missing.

rothses_2.m: It's OK, I guess. Not as good as I would like it to be, now that the gates to the town are closed. But people here still seem to need new pieces of leather every now and then.
r: Let me see what you have for sale.
Jhaeld sent me to ask you about the people that have gone missing.

rothses_20.m: Now, if you'll excuse me, I have things to do.

rothses_3.m:
Oh, I don't know much about that. Funny you should ask.
[Rothses gives you a suspicious look]
r: Are you sure? Anything you know or might have seen may be of interest.

rothses_4.m: Well, you would think that I see most of what is going on here, considering my shop is this close to Remgard's connecting entrance bridge.

rothses_5.m: However, I don't know anything about it. *cough*
r: Is there something you are not telling me?
Did the guards ask you about what you know?

rothses_6.m: Oh yes, they've been around asking everyone. I told them everything I know, already.

rothses_7.m: I did see Bethir the night before she disappeared. She had some equipment to sell. Nothing out of the ordinary though.

rothses_8.m: I did not see where she went after that.

rothses_9.m: Look, I told all this to the guards before. Are you implying anything?
r: I'll keep my eye on you.

rothses_c1.m: Our hero enters my shop. I am honored. How may I help you? A new set of boots perhaps, or some new gloves?
r: Let me see what you have for sale.
Jhaeld told me you could help me improve my equipment.

rothses_c2.m: Oh yes, I can make modifications to most of our defensive equipment that I sell. Want me to look through your things to see if there's anything I can improve for you?
r: No, I would not want you going through my stuff.

rothses_c3.m: Sure. I would be honored to have you back if you change your mind.

rothses_imp_armour.m: Now that is one fine looking chain mail you have there! For {3000} gold, I am able to improve it so that it not only blocks blows better, but also hinders your attacks less.
r: Maybe later. Do I have anything else that you can improve?

rothses_imp_armour_2.m: Here you go. One improved chain mail.
r: Do I have anything else that you can improve?

rothses_imp_armour_w.m: Now that is one fine looking chain mail you are wearing. Remove it from your chest and I might be able to help you improve it, if you want.

rothses_imp_gloves.m: Those are some nice looking combat gloves you have there. For 300 gold, I am able to improve them so that they block blows a bit better.
r: Maybe later. Do I have anything else that you can improve?

rothses_imp_gloves_2.m: Here you go. One pair of improved combat gloves.
r: Do I have anything else that you can improve?

rothses_imp_gloves_w.m: Those are some nice looking combat gloves you are wearing. Remove them from your hands and I might be able to help you improve them, if you want.

rothses_imp_n.m: No, you don't seem to have anything that I can improve. Come back later and I might be able to help you.

rothses_imp_shield.m: That's a nice looking Remgard shield you have there. For 700 gold, I am able to improve it so that it blocks blows a bit better.
r: Maybe later. Do I have anything else that you can improve?

rothses_imp_shield_2.m: Here you go. One improved Remgard shield.
r: Do I have anything else that you can improve?

rothses_imp_shield_w.m: That's a nice looking Remgard shield you are wearing. Remove it from your hands and I might be able to help you improve it, if you want.

remgard2.10: I have told Jhaeld, the village elder in Remgard, about the woman named Algangror that lives in the abandoned house to the east along the northern shore of the lake outside Remgard.
remgard2.20: Jhaeld told me that he would rather not deal with her, since he believes she is very dangerous. For the sake of his guards, he will not risk going against her since he is afraid of what might happen to all of them.
remgard2.21: If I want to help Jhaeld and the people of Remgard, I should find a way to make Algangror disappear. He also warns me to be extremely careful.
remgard2.30: Algangror admitted to me that she had made some people disappear from Remgard. She would not tell me what happened to them though.
remgard2.35: I have started attacking Algangror. I should return to Jhaeld with proof of defeating her when she is dead.
remgard2.40: I have told Jhaeld that I defeated Algangror.
remgard2.41: Jhaeld was very pleased to hear the good news. The people of Remgard should now be safe, and the town can be opened to outsiders again.
remgard2.45: For helping the people of Remgard find the cause of the disappearing people, Jhaeld told me to talk to Rothses. He might be able to improve some of my equipment.
remgard2.46: Ervelyn, the Remgard tailor, gave me a feathered hat as thanks for helping the people of Remgard find out what happened to the missing people.

remgard.10: I have reached the bridge to enter the town of Remgard. According to the bridge guard, the town is closed for outsiders to enter, and no-one is currently allowed to leave. They are investigating some disappearances of some of the townspeople.
remgard.15: I have offered my assistance in helping the people of Remgard investigate what has happened to the townspeople that have disappeared.
remgard.20: The bridge guard has asked me to investigate an abandoned house to the east along the northern shore of the lake. I should be wary of any inhabitants that may be there.
remgard.30: I have reported back to the bridge guard that I met Algangror in the abandoned house.
remgard.31: I have reported back to the bridge guard that the abandoned house was empty.
remgard.35: I have been granted entrance into Remgard. I should go visit Jhaeld, the town elder, to talk about what the next step should be. Jhaeld can probably be found in the tavern to the southeast.
remgard.40: Jhaeld was rather arrogant, but told me that they have had a problem with people disappearing for a while now. They have no clue what could be causing it.
remgard.50: I should visit four people in Remgard, and ask them about any clues on what might have happened to the missing people.
remgard.51: First is Norath, whose wife Bethir has disappeared. Norath can be found in the south-westernmost farmhouse.
remgard.52: Second, I should go talk to the Knights of Elythom, here in the tavern.
remgard.53: Third, I should go talk to the old woman Duaina in her house to the south.
remgard.54: Lastly, I should talk to Rothses, the armorer. He lives on the west side of town.
remgard.59: I tried to tell Jhaeld about Algangror, but he dismissed me as he had not heard me.
remgard.61: I have talked to Norath. He and his wife had been fighting recently, but he has no idea on what may have happened to her.
remgard.62: The Knights of Elythom in the Remgard tavern have had one of their knights disappearing recently. No one noticed anything when she disappeared, however.
remgard.63: Duaina has seen me in her visions. I did not understand all that she spoke of, but the parts that were clear were that me and Andor were parts of a larger plot. I wonder what this means? She did not speak of any disappearing people however, not that I could understand anyway.
remgard.64: Rothses told me that Bethir visited him the night before she disappeared, to sell some equipment. He did not see where she went after that.
remgard.70: I have talked to all of the people that Jhaeld wanted me to talk to, but did not get any information from any of them about what may have happened to the missing people. I should go back to Jhaeld and ask what his plans are next.
remgard.75: Jhaeld was really upset that I did not find out anything from the people that I was sent to talk to.
remgard.80: If I still want to help Jhaeld and the people of Remgard, I should look for clues in other places.
remgard.110: Jhaeld does not want to talk to me. I will not help them find out what happened to the missing people of Remgard.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
